source: hand-labelled: notes that plainly follow (confirm) or contradict (reverse) a decision or rule, and business calls no decision settles (owner)

items.note: A receipt is recorded even though the investor's KYC switch is off; matching stays blocked until KYC is set (D21).
The top bar says 'Could not refresh — showing nothing' when a Zoho fetch fails past the five-minute cache expiry, instead of showing the old numbers (D45).
In the logging flow the channel asked in step one is never asked again later in the flow (D57).
The signed PDF from Zoho Sign is filed to the allotment record, not to the Contact (D72).
Events are read from the Lead Events module; no Event_Name/Event_Date fields are written on the Lead (D85).
Lead-side Numbers are served from one global cache shared by every user, because the totals are the same for everyone (D53).
Screens for viewer seats read Zoho through the integration user's service token, since viewers never write (D53, D52).
New leads are written to a Supabase table first and synced to Zoho every ten minutes (D45).
The investor Contact is created only at Onboarded, after full payment, not at 'said yes' (D11).
An automated welcome email sent by a workflow rule is logged as the IR's conversation touch (rule 6).
The refund for a cancelled allotment is set at 95% of units × price; the owner has not said what is kept back.
The allocation letter's legal wording was drafted by the build from the prototype's placeholder text; no signed template exists yet.
Two more Enterprise seats are assumed for the Compliance team; buying them is not decided.
The KAM book assumes each KAM carries at most 40 investors; the owner has not set a staffing ratio.
The unit price of a farm unit is hard-coded at the last LLP's price until Finance supplies the new price list.
